prior_failure_review.what_changed: Runs bebfe230 and 35e542f8 each contain exactly one AT07 failure: probe_process. The runner copied the shared live_probe exit 1 to both ATs. bebfe230 AT06 failed audit_read, issue_reinstall and incarnation_history on browser 429; 35e542f8 AT06 failed only the obsolete zero-429 rate_limit_review. Neither has an independent AT07 assertion failure. Their review now requires this run's explicit successful probe processes and passing AT06 audit_read, issue_reinstall, incarnation_history and D-078 behavior review (browser/read under #252). Run 1d5c02a4 observed the second /24, one frozen conflict, one audit, a stable count, revoke 202, a new incarnation, and identity_conflict {mapping_frozen:false, conflict_count:0, last_conflict_at:null}. The clone's desired-state request returned HTTP 403. wget omitted --content-on-error, so the body was empty and the error code was not parsed. That process exit is the same parser miss. It is not a product conflict failure.

The real member was already authorized and the ordinary node already had a populated serving lease. Only serving_freeze_source failed, propagating exit 1 to both AT process rows. Freeze withdrawal/restart and all seven installer subset checks passed in that attempt.
